oneTimers: Investment gains are mostly paper gains: $9.2B of the quarter's $17.3B after-tax investment gains were unrealized — stocks Berkshire still owns went up in value. Next quarter they can just as easily go down.
'Other' operating earnings included about $331M of foreign-currency gains on non-dollar debt, versus a $1.1B loss a year ago — one reason that line swung from a $678M loss to a $1.4B profit.
otherDetail: Investment gains of $21,939M — mostly paper gains on Berkshire's stock portfolio — plus $330M of equity-method earnings, less $68M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

takeaways.text: The businesses themselves earned $13.5B after tax, up from $10.1B — insurance underwriting more than tripled to $2.4B, and manufacturing, service and retailing earned $3.6B.
takeaways.title: Operating earnings rose 34%

takeaways.text: Investment gains of $17.3B after tax — $9.2B of it unrealized gains on stocks Berkshire still holds, plus $8.2B realized on sales — turned a strong operating quarter into $30.8B of headline profit.
takeaways.title: Paper gains did the heavy lifting

takeaways.text: Insurance float — the premiums Berkshire holds and invests before it has to pay claims — reached about $176B, up $5B since the end of 2024.
takeaways.title: The float keeps growing

verdict: Berkshire's operating earnings rose 34% to $13.5B as insurance underwriting more than tripled — and $17.3B of after-tax investment gains lifted headline profit to $30.8B.
